page.name: Page
page.tailwind: bg-surface text-fg font-sans text-body font-normal leading-body
rules: One ground: warm gray paper with near-black ink, Satoshi at 16px on 24px lines. Never pure white, never pure black.
Structure is drawn with lines from the ink, not fills: nothing sits on white. A page may opt into the faint paper grain (ds-grain).
The dark theme swaps the ink and the ground; light is the default.

column.name: Content column
rules: A 1280px column inside 64px gutters. Heads stop at 720px and leads at 600px inside it.

section.name: Section
rules: 128px above and below; the head (index label, title, lead) sits 80px above the content, left aligned or centered.
Sections are divided by dashed guides (ds-rule-x, 10px dashes on an 18px period) or a quiet rule, never by a fill change. No entrance on scroll.

section-heading.name: Section heading
section-heading.tailwind: font-display text-h2 font-light leading-heading text-fg text-balance max-w-(--ds-layout-heading)
rules: Chakra Petch light at 44px (32px on 40px lines on a phone), balanced, at most 720px wide. Never bold.
One word may take the orange accent (a ds-accent span): flat orange, no gradient or glow.

section-description.name: Section description
section-description.tailwind: text-body-lg font-light leading-relaxed text-fg-secondary text-pretty max-w-(--ds-layout-text)
rules: The lead: Satoshi light at 18px on 28px lines in the graphite, 24px under the title, stopping at 600px (16px on 24px lines on a phone).

hero.name: Page head
hero.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center gap-6 pt-24 pb-16 text-center bg-surface
rules: A centered column at least a screen tall over line artwork drawn in the ink: a tag with a short note, the display title (32px under it), the lead (24px), the main and outlined keys side by side (40px), then a quiet note.
No photography, gradient or glow behind it: the art is ruled lines and hexagons, with orange only for what is done.

hero-title.name: Page title
hero-title.tailwind: font-display text-h3 sm:text-h2 font-light leading-heading tracking-tight text-fg text-balance
rules: Chakra Petch light at 44px (32px on a phone), the site's .heading, drawn 1 percent tighter and balanced. A page in an app keeps its proportions; the 64px display is for a marketing hero only. Never bold.
One accent word may be the flat orange (a ds-accent span).

hero-subtitle.name: Page description
hero-subtitle.tailwind: text-body-lg font-light leading-relaxed text-fg-secondary text-pretty max-w-(--ds-layout-text)
rules: The lead under the display title: 18px Satoshi light in the graphite, 24px below it, at most 560px wide.

eyebrow.name: Label
eyebrow.tailwind: font-mono text-caption font-normal leading-line-caption tracking-caps uppercase text-fg-label
rules: A label: Kode Mono at 12px in capitals, tracked 8 percent, in the quiet gray (ds-label). Eyebrows, section indexes (the number in the ink), column heads, dates and categories.

card.name: Card
card.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-4 p-8 border border-line rounded-none bg-surface shadow-none
rules: A card is a square frame of the quiet line on the same ground, 32px inside: never white, never a shadow, never rounded.
A card that is a link takes the 32 percent edge under the pointer (border-color, 120ms on the strong ease-out, gated to fine pointers); a static card does not react. Nothing moves.
Cards in a row share their rules (dashed guides between them) rather than each carrying a box.

card-raised.name: Raised panel
rules: Nothing is raised: a plan, a band of product art or a featured panel is framed in the stone line on the ground, square, with no shadow.
Plans side by side share one frame, split by the same stone rule.

window-bar.name: Code head
window-bar.tailwind: flex items-center justify-between gap-2 h-10 pl-5 border-b border-line-code bg-code-head text-code-head-fg font-mono text-caption leading-line-caption tracking-caps uppercase
rules: The 40px bar of a code block: the language as a Kode Mono label 20px in, and a Copy action at the right end ruled off by a quiet line (14px medium Satoshi, quiet until the pointer turns it ink).

card-title.name: Card title
rules: Chakra Petch at 24px on 32px lines in the ink (a plan or a band title); a group head in a table or a list is 20px.

body-text.name: Body text
rules: Copy under a title: Satoshi light at 16px on 24px lines in the graphite, pretty wrapped, at most 600px wide. Names and values stay in the ink.

caption.name: Caption
rules: Notes and small print: 14px on 20px lines in the quiet gray (12px in the footer). A date or a category is a Kode Mono label instead.

link.name: Link
rules: A text link is the medium 14px ink label over a quiet 1px rule, with an arrow after it (Read the quickstart →). Put the label and its arrow in a span.

Under the pointer or focus the rule wipes out and a dashed rule in the strong edge wipes in and marches (ds-link). Where pseudo-elements are not available, the underline turns dashed in the strong edge instead. The arrow never moves.
A link inside copy keeps the copy color with the quiet underline.

32px with 8px cuts and 16px sides in a header or toolbar; 48px on a touch screen.

The hexagon is painted by the background (a middle band and four corner triangles, the corners left clear), not cut with clip-path: the element stays a box, so the 2px focus outline around it is never clipped. A painted fill swaps at once under the pointer (a gradient cannot fade); the label color takes 160ms on the strong ease-out. A press takes its fill on pointer-down with no transition. Nothing moves or resizes: no scale, no bolder label.

No syntax rainbow: keywords take the orange, comments the slate, the rest the ink and its grays. Never a dark block on the light page.
A 40px bar above it carries the language as a label and a ruled Copy action.

media-frame.name: Media frame
rules: Product art and screenshots sit square in a stone frame on the ground (or inside corner ticks), never rounded, never shadowed.

48px rows split by a quiet rule: the row name in 14px graphite, values in the ink. Yes is a small filled ink hexagon, no a slate dash.

faq.name: FAQ row

rules: Ruled rows (a quiet rule between them and above the first) of 18px questions with a hexagon holding a plus at the end, 16px apart, 24px above and below (16px questions on a phone).
Open, the hexagon turns 30 degrees in 240ms on the strong ease-out and the plus becomes a minus; the answer is 16px light graphite, at most 600px wide.

footer.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-6 pt-16 pb-8 text-fg-secondary text-body-sm leading-line-body-sm
